therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunosuppression via calcineurin inhibition (tacrolimus), mTOR inhibition (sirolimus), and folate antagonism (methotrexate) vs calcineurin inhibition alone (cyclosporine)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of graft-versus-host disease while preserving immune reconstitution after allogeneic stem cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with hematologic malignancies undergoing unrelated donor stem cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with Grade II-IV acute GVHD at 6 months and chronic GVHD at 2 years, plus immune reconstitution parameters

results.effect_size: Acute GVHD Grade II-IV: TMS 42% vs AC 38%; Moderate/Severe chronic GVHD: TMS 50% vs AC 12%; Overall survival: TMS 41.7 months vs AC 18.8 months
biomarker_changes: TMS arm showed better naive CD4 T cell recovery at 6 and 12 months (24% vs 1% at 6 months)
TMS arm showed better naive CD8 T cell recovery at 6 and 12 months (20% vs 3% at 6 months)
TMS arm showed better T cell receptor repertoire diversity (lower divergence index) at all timepoints
TMS arm showed faster lymphocyte engraftment (16 vs 76 days median)
subgroup_findings: Severe chronic GVHD: TMS 28% vs AC 5%
Grade III-IV acute GVHD: TMS 13% vs AC 21%
safety_signals: Elevated ALT/AST more common in TMS arm (4/44 vs 1/45)
ARDS occurred only in AC arm (5/45)
Early treatment-related mortality: TMS 1 patient, AC 0 patients
Late treatment-related mortality similar: TMS 28% vs AC 29%
results.dose_information: Tacrolimus 0.02 mg/kg/day IV initially, Sirolimus 12 mg loading dose then 4 mg daily, Methotrexate 5 mg/m2 on days +1,+3,+6,+11; Cyclosporine IV over 2 hours or orally every 12 hours

context.duration: Treatment through day +180 post-transplant with tapering, follow-up average up to 5 years
